column4: the world map from the project coastline with place names and the dotted route (map.png); the fight in battle.png: outlined pixel figures, amber leader, hedrons in the sky. Only the Tazeem backdrop was seen in a shot; the other six (art.js:320), the shake on landfall (battle.js:233) and the hedron sway are in code

coastline and the 15 places come from the map project (world-data.js), card and enemy names, numbers and places from its saga 1 phase 1 data (lore-data.js), official Korean names used where printed (cards.js cardName)

2D fixed screens: the whole world from above (map.png); the fight from the player side with the leader left, the enemy right and the hand below (battle.png); 640x360 scaled by 2 in the 1280x720 window (index.html:44)

seven continents, 15 named places of 2009, numbered stops you can still reach, town, wilds, great beast and camp in the legend. Travel was run by key (Digit1); travel by mouse click is in code (screens.js:112) and was not machine-checked

4 starter kinds and 5 lands plus 28 cards split by continent; after the fight the replay took one of the three offered and the deck went from 10 to 11 (map.png). The reward screen (screens2.js:241) was not captured in a shot

in the replay Island was played with Adventuring Gear out: the spider attacked for 6 and hp fell by 2 (68/70 in map.png). Gaining a land on a new continent (screens.js:121) is in code; the replay stayed on Tazeem
four trap cards (cards.js) cost 0 when their intent condition holds (trapMet, costOf); no trap was in hand in the replay, so this is by code

six wild kinds, two great beasts and the Roil Elemental, each its own outline (figures.png); an intent icon over the enemy (battle.png, Webbing); the attack number and the incoming line that counts block are at screens2.js:71 and screens2.js:83

L switched every text on the map to English (map-en.png) from Korean (map.png) and the run reported the pick saved (localstorage zx-lang); card names and card text go through cardName and cardText (cards.js). English card faces were not captured in a shot

dragging a card and the hover panel need a pointer, and sound cannot be seen in a shot: the check could only press keys (its click carries no position). In code: drag and drop (screens2.js:30), keyword help (screens.js:347), one effect at a time (battle.js:191), hit pitch rising through a chain (index.html:123, battle.js:157), the mute button (screens.js:55)
the KO/EN button and L (screens.js:55, text.js:19); the same map in both languages (map.png, map-en.png)
every unvisited stop on every continent is offered from where you stand; distance only costs days (screens.js:88, screens.js:72)
the title says Enter or click to begin (index.html:170); the map opens on day 0 with the marker at Sea Gate (map-en.png)
the stops you can reach carry a number and a blinking frame (screens.js:175); the numbers show in the shot, the blink is motion

Digit1 sent the marker along the dotted line to Oran-Rief and the first fight opened; the first hand is FIRST_HAND (cards.js:277), energy 3 (battle.png shows 3/3 on turn 2). The spider first intent of 6 (recluse_atk, first fight at full damage) was not captured in a shot
two machetes took the spider from 18 to 6 (battle.png 6/18) and block soaked the hit (hp 68/70). The card in flight (battle.js:194) and the rising numbers (battle.js:157) are motion, by code
Island with Adventuring Gear gave 4 block: the 6 attack cost 2 hp (map.png 68/70). The shake is motion, by code
after the kill the replay pressed 1 on the reward and the deck went 10 to 11 (map.png); skip is S (screens2.js:241)
back on the map after the reward, with the next stops numbered
the first fight enemy has 75% hp: 18 instead of 24 (battle.png 6/18)

the baloth marks its ground, then charges for 10 x 2 = 20 of 70 hp and 4% more each day, 22 on day 2 (enemies.js:47, config.js:115, config.js:15). By the numbers only: when the second fight comes depends on the player, and no check played it
great beasts show on the map as their own icon; a town is a market (screens2.js:296); a camp is rest or remove a card (screens2.js:341)

enemy hp and damage grow 4% a day (config.js:15); when day 8 is reached the Roil Elemental fight starts where you stand (screens.js:139, screens.js:142). The boss and the two great beasts were sized by arithmetic for a deck of about 16 cards, never by play. By code: the replay did not reach day 8
hp 68/70 carried out of the fight onto the map; at 0 hp the run ends (battle.js:327, screens2.js:389)
each new run draws a new seed (index.html:147): two rough ways (+1 day) are picked afresh, the deck order, the enemies opening moves and the card offers change (battle.js:47, battle.js:335)
